integrity.claim_consistency: The sole theorem concerns the global basin, exact sharp transient and induced Haar-random gain risk of the balanced planar coupled flow. All verification details refer to this theorem.
integrity.numerical_versus_proof: Exact algebraic proof is primary; numerical integration is supplemental only.

scientific_limitations: The deterministic and Haar-random gain conclusions apply to the unaccelerated rank-one coupled flow on a planar quadratic saddle with equal absolute positive and negative Hessian eigenvalues. It gives no corresponding sharp result for general nonlinear or anisotropic potentials. Historical priority remains subject to undiscovered literature.
title: Global transient pulse and sharp misalignment gain in a planar coupled saddle flow
